0:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)><im(1)>Everyone, stay where you are and listen.
Commodore #c[E2E258]Cowen#c will brief us
on our operations from here on.
1:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>This is Cowen. From now on, the #c[5E8FD8]Albion#c<im(2)>
will operate under my command.
I'm counting on you.
2:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>First, let me explain what comes next.
The #c[5E8FD8]Albion#c will continue<im(4)>
its pursuit of #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c.
3:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>Ensign Uraki and Lt. Kepford, you will
also remain with the #c[5E8FD8]Albion#c team
for the pursuit.
4:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>The situation is grave.
That #c[BE5050]Unit 2#c carries a nuclear warhead
banned under the #c[E2E258]Antarctic Treaty#c.
5:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>Why the #c[BE5050]Zeon remnants#c acted now,
we still don't know...
but we cannot let them keep it.
6:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>We've also confirmed the #c[BE5050]Zeon remnants#c
were working with #c[BE5050]Giganos#c. What #c[BE5050]Giganos#c
wants will be looked into by #c[5E8FD8]Intelligence#c.
7:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>And then there's that unidentified force...
We know nothing about them at all,
neither who they are nor what they want.
8:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>Taking all this together, it's fair to say
this is the worst situation imaginable.
9:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>There's much to be done, but
recovering #c[BE5050]Unit 2#c<im(5)> is the top priority.
I'm counting on you.
10:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>I've also received word that the pilot of
#c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c is #c[BE5050]Zeon#c's ace,
#c[E2E258]Major Anavel Gato#c.
11:
<op(39,1)><sp(2)>Stay fully on your guard.
That is all from me.
13:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>I'm sorry. From the state of her unit, it's
been judged she could not have survived.
14:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>She's been declared killed in action and
promoted two ranks... Not that it's
much of a consolation.
15:
<op(38,1)><sp(2)>Kepford, carry out your duty well,
for Ensign Carson's sake, too.
That's all I can say for now... Dismissed.
